items.t: Bitmine Says Its Controls Are Still Not Effective as ETH Ended the Year $5.4 Billion Below Cost
items.sum: The ether treasury company’s annual report also details a $143.7 million derivatives loss and a new 1.5% staking-fee deal with an Ethereum Tower affiliate.

items.t: Tom Lee’s Ethereum Bet Is Costing Bitmine Billions On Paper, And He’s Still Buying
items.sum: Bitmine sold 395.1 million shares for $13.2 billion in total profits and repurchased 20.8 million shares at $17 each to support its purchases.

items.t: Bitmine Immersion Technologies, Inc. Announces ETH Holdings Reach 6.07 Million Tokens and Total Holdings of $14.3 Billion
Tom Lee’s Bitmine Adds $20M in Ethereum, Seizing on Vitalik’s 'ETH Is Money' Declaration
items.sum: The firm’s stash reached 6.07 million ETH—4.97% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee called Vitalik Buterin’s “ETH is money” comments a “seismic shift.”

items.t: Strategy Makes Biggest Bitcoin Purchase Since September, While Bitmine, Strive Slow Down
items.sum: Strategy bought 1,036 Bitcoin over the past week, marking its second consecutive week of buying.
